question: The Moth ki Masjid was built in the reign of ______ ruler.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Sikandar Lodi.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Moth ki Masjid** is located in **Delhi, India.**
 
• It was built in the **15th century **during the reign of the **Lodi dynasty.**
 
• The mosque is known for its **unique architectural style** and **intricate designs.**
 
• Firuz Shah Tugluq, Muhammad Tughluq, and Bahlul Lodi were rulers of the Delhi Sultanate but did not build the Moth ki Masjid.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Firuz Shah Tugluq** was a ruler of the Tugluq dynasty who ruled from **1351 to 1388.** 

 
 
• He is known for his contributions to the** development of Delhi,** including the construction of **many public works.**
 
 
 
• **Muhammad Tughluq **was a ruler of the Tughluq dynasty who ruled from** 1325 to 1351.** 
 
 
• He is known for his ambitious but ultimately unsuccessful attempts at **administrative reform.**
 
 
 
• **Bahlul Lodi** was a ruler of the Lodi dynasty who ruled from **1451 to 1489.** 
 
 
• He is known for his **military campaigns** and expansion of the Lodi empire.
